definition: in some place that is not known
description: A huge sunflower field on a hot sunny day. A young woman with a ponytail, in a white shirt and rust shorts, stands on a wooden crate with her hands cupped around her mouth, calling out across the tall flowers. Then she shades her eyes with one hand, looks out over the field searching, and smiles. An empty red dog lead lies on the crate at her feet. In the distance stand a stone farmhouse, dark cypress trees and an old cart under a clear blue sky.
